On October 20, 2023, a significant withdrawal of INR 235,000 was made from the same account [D83F04FF8800], which further raises suspicions. This large withdrawal may be an attempt to launder funds or facilitate illegal activities.

The cumulative total of these transactions is INR 523,000, which exceeds the reporting threshold amount. The fact that the initial series of transactions were structured to avoid reporting and the subsequent large withdrawal suggest a potential money laundering scheme.

Therefore, it is reasonable to suspect that the account holder may be engaged in structuring to evade the PAN reporting threshold or attempting to launder funds.
